title: The Client Offboarding Experience
short_teaser: The end of a service can include review, handoff, celebration, and next-step guidance.
story: The end of a service can include review, handoff, celebration, and next-step guidance. A strong ending protects the value of the entire relationship. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A strong ending protects the value of the entire relationship. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust through the decisions beneath the visible offer.
